description:
An archived issue record may omit `archived_from`, and revive logic keeps a fallback for that legacy shape. Every archived record in this repository carries the field.

## Background

- The `archived_from` field doc (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:475-489`) names legacy records.
- Revive keeps an explicit fallback: the `None` arm at `commands/mod.rs:1030-1045` warns "archived before its pre-archive state was recorded".
- `effective_terminal_state` (`types.rs:120-126`) has no special branch, but its doc (`:113-115`) mentions legacy records.
- All 41 archived records here carry the field, and no non-archived record does.
- Writers: `commands/mod.rs:1212-1216` and `repository_state/archive.rs:208-211`.

Every issue load path goes through the derived `Deserialize` on `Issue` (`types.rs:411`): `storage/json.rs:132,920`, `storage/memory.rs:463,473`, `validation/repository.rs:377`. A plain required field cannot express the rule, because the field is absent on non-archived issues. The check therefore belongs at the decode boundary, through `serde(try_from)` or a hand `Deserialize`. schemars 0.8 ignores `serde(try_from)` (its `SERDE_KEYWORDS` in `schemars_derive-0.8.22/src/attr/schemars_to_serde.rs` omit it), so the derived `Issue` schema keeps describing the struct's own fields, `archived_from` included.

Tests that construct archived issues without the field:

- `commands/archive.rs:965,2572` and `domain/artifact_classifier.rs:1916,1923`.
- `tests/fast_issue/archived_semantics_tests.rs` builds legacy records on purpose (`save_legacy_archived` at `:30`; legacy dependency and revive tests at `:89,190`). Those legacy-record tests are deleted.
- `tests/fast_docs_templates/harness_demo.rs:502` seeds an archived issue without the field, decoded by `InMemoryStorage` through `serde_json::from_slice::<Issue>` (`storage/memory.rs:463`). It is rewritten to carry an origin state.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Decoding an archived issue record without `archived_from` fails with an error naming the field, on every load path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Revive logic and `effective_terminal_state` hold no legacy-record branch, and their docs do not mention legacy records.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tests construct archived issues with an origin state, and the issue JSON schema still describes `archived_from`.
- [hard] REQ-04: One owning domain test proves the decode rejection.

## Notes

The decode check stays pure and I/O-free in the domain layer.
title: Require archived_from on archived issue records
